title: system monitor strip and large-screen layout

commit.merge_subject: merge: system monitor strip and large-screen layout

description:
A thin GPU/CPU/RAM/DISK strip above every screen (under the status
bar, editor included), sampled once a second only while shown;
Settings > Appearance hides it (SystemMonitorStore, project.json key
"systemMonitor", default shown).

- CPU: the app's share of all cores (/proc/self/stat deltas; Android
  8+ blocks /proc/stat).
- GPU: device busy % from kgsl/Mali sysfs when readable; otherwise the
  app's own GPU share from per-frame GL_TIME_ELAPSED queries in the
  preview session (non-blocking ring of 4, disjoint-checked), exposed
  as nativePreviewGpuNanos. On the test phone every kgsl node is
  SELinux-denied, so the timer path is the one that runs.
- RAM: system used/total; DISK: data volume used, free shown wide.

Large screens (>= 600dp): browse nav becomes a NavigationRail, the
library and folder grids add columns past the phone's 3
(AdaptiveMinGridCells, 168dp min cell), settings c
